mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 73 degrees with overcast skies along the Military Ridge State Trail. Tonight, we will see a low of 56 degrees with no rain in the forecast. If you look to the skies at 7:36 PM, you can catch the space station rising in the west near Mount Horeb and heading toward the northeast near Madison for 5 minutes.

Verona Police recently released a summary of calls ranging from September 14, including a notable arrest on September 5 where a driver was stopped for speeding and had license restrictions regarding alcohol consumption.

There is plenty to do in Verona, starting with trivia today at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, or a trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
On September 10, officers responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where a suspect fired a weapon; the individual was quickly detained and is facing multiple charges.
The Culver's in Verona is currently closed for a remodel, so we do not have a flavor of the day to share at this time.
